SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Raw keyboard input
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Sends each key directly and disables suggestions. Off (default) keeps a normal text field so keyboard mic keys and voice typing work.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Send after dictation
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Press Enter automatically after voice input is inserted.

Preference.android:title: Update Claude Code and Codex
Preference.android:summary: Runs npm install -g for both CLIs inside Ubuntu.

Preference.android:title: Allow access to phone storage
Preference.android:summary: Grants All files access so /sdcard is visible inside Ubuntu.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Disable proot seccomp acceleration
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Turn on only if sessions fail to start on this device (slower).

Preference.android:title: Reinstall Ubuntu environment
Preference.android:summary: Deletes the whole Linux environment, including files in /root.

Preference.android:title: Voice input not working?
Preference.android:summary: Shows which speech engine this phone provides and the alternatives.

Preference.android:title: Sessions get killed in the background?
Preference.android:summary: Android 12+ limits child processes. Tap for the one-time adb fix.
